context_for_next_testing_agent: Build pipeline is clean. craco.config.js owns ESLint config (plugin:react-hooks/recommended). Do not reintroduce /app/frontend/.eslintrc.json or an eslintConfig block in package.json — it will re-trigger the Plugin "react-hooks" conflict during production `yarn build`. Flat eslint.config.js at /app/frontend/eslint.config.js is intentional and ignored by CRA's legacy ESLint.
rca of the issue: CRA's build-time ESLint (via craco) reads legacy configs (.eslintrc.json AND BaseConfig). The old .eslintrc.json extended plugin:react-hooks/recommended while craco.config.js also configured the same plugin via `eslint.configure.extends`, causing ESLint to throw a plugin-conflict error. Removing the legacy .eslintrc.json leaves craco as the single source of truth and resolves the conflict. Mitigation: keep ESLint config only in craco.config.js (or only in a legacy file), never both.
